products.name: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Secure Baseline — Commercial
products.short_description: Run Kubernetes securely on Azure — an AKS secure baseline with private networking, Entra RBAC, policy, and workload identity.
products.description:
Run Kubernetes securely on Azure — an AKS secure baseline with private networking, Entra RBAC, policy, and workload identity.

A default AKS cluster is a soft target: public API, broad RBAC, no policy, secrets in env vars. This solution deploys an AKS secure baseline — private cluster networking, Entra ID integration with Kubernetes RBAC, Azure Policy for Kubernetes (Gatekeeper), workload identity for pod-to-Azure auth, image scanning, and Defender for Containers.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run automation (Terraform, Bicep & scripts).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Private cluster networking (private API, CNI, ingress) as code
  • Entra ID + Kubernetes RBAC and least-privilege access
  • Azure Policy for Kubernetes (Gatekeeper) guardrails
  • Workload identity (federated) for secretless pod-to-Azure auth
  • Defender for Containers, image scanning, and node hardening

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A production-grade, policy-guardrailed AKS baseline with private networking and secretless identity — not an internet-exposed default cluster.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 3 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AKSSEC-Discovery.ps1 — read-only readiness check for an AKS secure-baseline deploy:
    • AKSSEC-Report.ps1 — a consolidated AKS secure-baseline posture report: cluster hardening,
    • AKSSEC-Validate.ps1 — confirm the deployed AKS cluster meets the secure baseline:

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
